content.p1: $t(common:name) helps you fit your event around everyone's schedules. Simply create an event above and send the link to everyone that is participating. Results update live and you will be able to see a heat-map of everyone's preferences. The best time for your desired event duration is calculated using <1>STAR Voting</1>.<3/><4>Learn more about how to $t(common:name)</4>.
content.p3: Built on <1>Star Fit</1>, $t(common:name) is the modern-day solution to your group event planning debates.
content.p4: The code for $t(common:name) is open source, if you find any issues or want to contribute, you can visit the <1>repository</1>.
content.p6: To protect your privacy, events are deleted after 3 months of inactivity, and all passwords are securely hashed.
content.p5: Consider donating below if it helped you out so $t(common:name) can stay free for everyone. ⭐️
